svg.text: 3 ESP32 nodes + 1 camera · power strip → 12V 5A PSU → 14 AWG pigtail → WAGO → fused 18 AWG branches → 2 switch boards · STEMMA QT sensor chain · 2 smart plugs
OUTSIDE THE CHAMBER — the dry side
CHAMBER WALL — 7/8 in. grommet / tent cable port
power strip, 12 V supply, chargers, Pi, smart plugs and both switch boards
sensors, camera and 12 V loads only — no supplies, chargers or switch boards
USB-A → micro-USB, 6 ft (2 m) → the camera's ESP32-CAM-MB
USB-A → USB-C, 6 ft (2 m) → the climate ESP32 (in the chamber)
relay_board_mount, node="relay" — 4 switch channels, a UF4007 on every one
100R gate · 10K pull-down · IRLZ44N · UF4007 across J2
the pump channel in All the Things
fresh-air intake at the wall · fan_duct
Fans: bundled 30 cm extension + Noctua NA-SEC3 4-pin extension (cut its far end): GND → J2 −,
+12 V → J2 + — identify by pin position, not colour; tach + PWM unused (heat-shrink them).
no diodes — LED strips are resistive
the strip's RED wire, later — no re-flash
the strip's GREEN wire (730 nm), later
White 6500K LED strip — JOYLIT 5 m roll, cut to closet length
red → J2 +, black → J2 − (18 AWG red/black pair)
BLUE wire (450 nm) → J2 − of CH1
RED wire (660 nm) — insulated with heat-shrink for now
GREEN wire (730 nm far-red) — insulated for now
Tri-spectrum strip, IP67 — one strip, one 4-wire lead
SuperLightingLED p-7120 · cut to length · heat-shrink every joint

g.text: MQTT over WiFi — no wires from the Pi to any node or plug

svg.text: Plugs: User sp-3p, Topic = role, Full Topic tasmota/%topic%/%prefix%/ (required)
Space heater ≤ 1500 W, outside, aimed at the intake
or a Peltier cooler at the wall (Topic heater / cooler)
ESP32-CAM on its ESP32-CAM-MB · OV2640 or OV3660 · cam_mount
cam-01 · no GPIO wiring · flash LED (GPIO 4) · 15-30 cm from the substrate
QT chain, not a star: 4397 → SHT31-D, 4210 → SCD41, 4210 → BH1750
sensor_mount + sensor_bracket: chamber centre, substrate level
One switch-board channel, end to end — CH0 (FAE fan) on relay_board_mount
Every relay and lighting channel is this circuit; the lighting board leaves out the UF4007 and feeds a strip instead of a fan.
COMMON GROUND: ESP32 GND → J1 − → GND bus → WAGO 221-415 → PSU −. Leave it out and the gate has no reference — the channel never switches. Do it on both boards.
RED = +12 V (and 3V3 on the QT cable)
Wire: 14 AWG pigtail · 18 AWG red/black for every 12 V run · 22 AWG hookup wire or
Dupont for GPIO / GND → J1. Adhesive-lined heat-shrink on every splice; zip-tie every run.
12 V branches and fuses (inline blade fuse on each +12 V branch)
Relay board: 3 A — three NF-A8 fans draw ~0.25 A together.
Lighting board: 5 A — the LED strips are the real load.
12V 5A PSU: keep the total ≤ ~4 A — cut the strips to closet length
(a full white roll alone is 3.3-4.2 A). GND branches are not fused.
12-outlet strip outside: Pi PSU, 12 V PSU, 4 chargers, 2 plugs.
221-413 → inline 3 A fuse → relay +12 V bus (18 AWG red).
221-413 → inline 5 A fuse → lighting +12 V bus (18 AWG red).
221-415 → both boards' GND bus (18 AWG black).
GPIO → Dupont jumper → J1 IN → 100R → IRLZ44N gate.
10K from gate to source; source → GND bus.
UF4007 across J2 on every relay channel, band to +12 V.
ESP32 GND → J1 − on both boards: the COMMON GROUND.
Fans: NA-SEC3 extension, far end cut — GND → J2 −, +12 V → J2 +.
FAE on CH0 (GPIO 25), exhaust CH1 (26), circulation CH2 (27).
Strips: 18 AWG red/black, red → J2 +, black → J2 −.
Tri-spectrum: BLUE wire → CH1 J2 −, common wire → +12 V.
Insulate its red + green wires; heat-shrink every joint.
4397: red 3V3, black GND, blue GPIO 21, yellow GPIO 22.
Climate + camera: 6 ft (2 m) USB cables through the grommet.
Relay + lighting ESP32s stay outside on short cables.
Plugs: WiFi only — sp-3p + Full Topic (see the build guide).
ESP32-S3 boards use other pins: build guide §8a.
